description: Marvin auto-recall: budgeted session-start memory context and per-prompt lexical recall via the marvin CLI. Guarded so a missing marvin binary (or broken vault) never breaks a session — the hook silently no-ops.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v marvin >/dev/null 2>&1 && marvin hook session-start || true'
sh -c 'command -v marvin >/dev/null 2>&1 && marvin hook user-prompt || true'
